Printer contract (reference renderFormula, line 1170; studio invariant I1):
- ModelFormula.render returns tokens (text, kind = function/argument-name/value/operator/literal, termIndex, argPath, status = accepted | proposed(reason)). The studio shows proposed tokens dotted with the reason and lists them in a footer.
- Modulated terms print as two terms: the main effect hrf(factors, …, id = x) and the slopes hrf(factors, modulators(...), …, id = x_mod) — because hrf(x, modulators(...)) builds slopes only (see SF5/G39).
- Factor-less terms need the admitted all-events form (G39); single-trial terms print trialwise(...) with per-argument status (G41).
- Expressions in subsets and derived columns print vectorized & and | (not && ||), Unicode minus normalized to '-'.
- Parser keeps source positions on every node so errors point at the argument; JSON codec for ModelFormula, HrfSpec, ContrastSpec and ModelBuildSpec (ledger G5).
Acceptance:
- parse(render(f)) == f and build(parse(render(f))) has the same columns (count, identity, values within tolerance) for the five example studies, their LSA/LSS states and the n/a policy states of the 42-state grid (audit/m7b-methods/grid.txt shows the expected printed lines per state).
- A whitelist check: every token printed as accepted must be accepted by FormulaParser (the mock gate C25 implements this against FormulaParser.scala:459/497 at 7c3ff0a; see checks.cjs).

Example studies for fixtures: STUDIES (line 424): block localizer (TR 2, N 180), mixed gambles (N 240; gain, loss, gain×loss), delayed match-to-sample (N 210; sample/delay/probe/errors phases; accuracy), stop signal (N 200; FIR 10×2 s; rt n/a for successful stops, ssd n/a for go), category × attention (N 240; 12 cells × canonical+temporal+dispersion; 24 motion). Runs use seeds 11 and 29; motion from motionSet (418); FD/censoring and confounds in regenMotion (499).
